### problem_chain

1. "The advance payment is not fixed until the late fee owed for every billing month whose tuition was left unpaid after its due day has been assessed." Months checked: 2026-08 (due 07-17 by P2's sentence / paid 07-15), 09 (due 09-05, paid 09-04), 10 (due 10-05, paid 10-08 -> late, fee row 4c38afeb present), 11 (due 11-05, paid 11-05, not after), 12 (due 12-05; by 12-05 only 50.00 paid -> left unpaid after its due day; no enroll_tuition_late_fee row with billing_month 2026-12) -> unmet at the opening. Resolver: P2's rule (the late-fee schedule) -> post_prek_late_fee_f766f23b.
2. "... fixed only after the combined-program credit owed on the most recent billing month has been worked out and posted for a child who attends Creek Kids Club Pre-K Wraparound Care (5 Days)." Lucia's care enrollment is that plan, active; the December charge d1b82598 has no credit row against it -> unmet. Resolver: P1 -> credit_prek_combined_program_abf513c1.
P2 and P1 carry no prerequisite sentences of their own. Derived tree: P3 <- P2 (value_input: open_balance), P3 <- P1 (value_input: advance_month_rate and open_balance); n = 2 prerequisite problems, 2 value_input edges (>= max(1,1)); acyclic; one owner=user write (the root). Isomorphic to the declared `prerequisite` field.
- Load-bearing runs (own recomputation): skip P2 -> advance 2448.95; skip P1 -> 2661.43; both differ from the full-path 2454.43 below.
- Parallel edges: P2 and P1 commute (P2 reads charges/late fees/refunds/payments and care status; P1 reads the latest charge and care rows) — one terminal state in either order.
- No wait: both writes are immediate agent postings. Tool bodies (task_tools.py) check only formats and source-row existence; none checks a prerequisite.
- Persona: raises only the root ("pay off the rest of Lucia's Pre-K tuition for the school year in one payment today"), states the authorisation boundary (quote; she pays herself in the portal; no card; bank draft), mentions care and December payments only if asked, consents to postings "If the person tells you something has to be posted or applied", closes after reading back the confirmation.
